                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The question uses the phrase "you've ever read", indicating a comparison among all the books read so far.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This requires the superlative form of the adjective "interesting".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The correct superlative form is "the most interesting", as "interesting" is a multi-syllable adjective and forms its comparative/superlative with "more" and "most".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Options like "more interesting" are comparative, not superlative, and "the interesting" is grammatically incorrect in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 1: "interesting" is incorrect as it lacks the necessary comparison or emphasis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 3: "more interesting" is a comparative adjective, used when comparing two things—not suitable here.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 4: "the interesting" is grammatically incorrect as it lacks a proper noun to follow and is not a superlative form.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In the present simple tense, the correct auxiliary verb used with plural subjects is "do".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Does" is used for singular third-person subjects (e.g., he, she, it).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Had" is past tense and not suitable here, and "has" is used for possession, not for forming questions in the present tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

(चाहिए)\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "Obsequious" means excessively eager to please or obey someone, often to a servile or fawning degree. (चापलूस)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The obsequious employee always agreed with the boss, even when he disagreed internally.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Obstinate" refers to someone who is stubborn and unwilling to change their opinion or behavior despite reasonable arguments or persuasion. (हठी)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: She remained obstinate and refused to admit that she was wrong, even after seeing the evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Thus, the antonym of 'obsequious' is 'obstinate', as they represent opposite traits: one being overly submissive and the other being stubborn.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 (Obstinate).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Obliterate (मिटा देना): To destroy completely, leaving no trace.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The town was obliterated by the earthquake, leaving nothing but rubble.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ostracised (बहिष्कृत): To exclude someone from a group or society, often as a form of punishment.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nDespite his initial ________, he eventually agreed to join the team.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "enthusiasm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "reluctance"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "determination"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "compassion"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is 'reluctance'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The sentence uses the word "Despite," indicating contrast between the initial feeling and the final action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Reluctance" means unwillingness or hesitation to do something, which fits logically with someone eventually agreeing despite initial hesitation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "he eventually agreed" confirms that his initial state was contrary, hence "reluctance" is appropriate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Other options like "enthusiasm", "determination", and "compassion" do not create the required contrast.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Complete Sentence: Despite his initial reluctance, he eventually agreed to join the team.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Enthusiasm (उत्साह): intense interest or eagerness—opposite in meaning to what's implied here.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Determination (दृढ़ संकल्प): firmness of purpose—not showing hesitation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Compassion (दया): sympathy or concern for others—unrelated to willingness or agreement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n151:T692,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nIndustrialisation gives even the least talented person a chance to ____________ his livelihood.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Live"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Give"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Earn"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Break"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is 'earn'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "earn his livelihood" is a standard and correct expression that means to make a living or to support oneself financially.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The verb "earn" appropriately fits the context of receiving income or sustenance through work or industrial opportunities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Other verbs such as "live", "give", or "break" do not logically or grammatically fit in this phrase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Complete Sentence: Industrialisation gives even the least talented person a chance to earn his livelihood.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Live: means to be alive or exist; it does not fit the expression "live his livelihood."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Give: means to provide something to someone; incorrect in the context of earning a living.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Break: generally refers to separating or damaging; it is not associated with livelihood or income.
