                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "elder" is used only for comparing the age of persons within a family or close relations (e.g., my elder brother).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In general comparisons of age outside the family context, the correct adjective is "older."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Additionally, "than" is the correct conjunction used after comparative adjectives like "older."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, the phrase should be "older than," making Option 4 the grammatically correct choice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Correct Sentence: "Mr. Wilson is older than he looks."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 1 – "older then" is incorrect because "then" is used for time sequence, not comparison.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 2 – "elder to" is incorrect since "elder" is not used with "to" and is inappropriate outside family context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 3 – "elder for" is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended comparison.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is: Option 2 (Awsome).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "Awsome" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling of the word is "Awesome".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Meaning of Awsome: The word "Awsome" does not exist in English as it is incorrectly spelt.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Hindi Meaning: None, as the word is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: None, as the word is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Correct Word: The correct word is "Awesome" (आश्चर्यजनक).\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Meaning: Something that inspires awe or amazement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Hindi Meaning: आश्चर्यजनक
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The view from the mountaintop was simply awesome.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 (Awsome).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Awful (भयानक): Something very bad or unpleasant.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The food at the restaurant was awful, and we couldn't eat it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Bitter (कड़वा): Having a sharp, pungent taste or feeling of resentment.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The medicine had a bitter taste, but it was effective.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Barren (बंजर): Land that is too poor to produce plants or vegetation; unproductive.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The farmer struggled to cultivate crops on the barren land.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n17f:Ta38,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is: Option 3 (ought", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Spellings"], "concept": "Spelling", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "67b09423a8a428353e47aa3a", "qs_no": 21, "pos_marks": 3.0, "neg_marks": 1.0, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": " Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "on"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "for"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "to"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "with"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is 'to'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The verb "refers" is commonly followed by the preposition "to" in standard English usage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "refers to" means "to mention" or "to be about" something, which fits the context of introducing the definition of opera.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Other prepositions like "on", "for", and "with" are grammatically incorrect after "refers" in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, the appropriate phrase is "Opera refers to a dramatic art form..."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Complete Sentence: Opera refers to a dramatic art form, originating in Europe, in which the emotional content is conveyed to the audience...
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • On: Generally used to indicate position or surface—e.g., "on the table."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For: Used to indicate purpose—e.g., "This is for you."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • With: Indicates association or instrumentality—e.g., "He came with his friend."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
